Type: City
First Mentioned: Pre-session notes

Description

The capital city of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.aHJXqousaIFYnECh]{Marrow County}, once a crown jewel of the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.yAiIJMlC7flCgMRm]{Imperium Lucis Aeternae} famed for its gold production.
The Imperium possessed magical or technological means to extract gold from substrate rock — knowledge lost since the Imperium's fall.
When the gold ran out, Aurelion declined into relative unimportance, leaving it vulnerable to @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold}'s expansion.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} fought in the war that brought Aurelion under Beaconhold's control.
Seat of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Albrecht Marrow}'s power and center of the county's administration.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.v85bRcnzMrFiDdn6]{The Nodrum} is located not far from the city.
The surrounding countryside shows decline: thin fields, sparse orchards, and a once-grand imperial road now lightly traveled.
The city employs dog catchers to deal with a stray dog problem.
The party is wanted in Aurelion — posters accuse them of subverting the county and stealing goods on behalf of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Albrecht Marrow}.

@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Crest Aurelion}

@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Albrecht Marrow}'s castle and seat of power for @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.aHJXqousaIFYnECh]{Marrow County}, perched atop the city hill like a vault rather than a castle.
Contains a massive vault with diminishing gold reserves and a secret passage connecting it to the count's private chambers, discovered by @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} during @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold}'s conquest centuries ago.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold} conquered Crest Aurelion by forcing the capitulation of a Morrow ancestor who ruled it.

@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{The Chryseum}

The cathedral of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{The Light} in the city, presided over by @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Luminary Severin Morrow}.
Features a massive gold dome that dominates the skyline — the last prominent reminder of the city's golden past.
The interior features a massive @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.pbvNoEuQV2PoM8wM]{Whiteglass} stained-glass window radiating clean light, rows of pews, soaring vaults of white gold and candlelight, and a mysterious swirling pattern on the nave floor.
The church was built over an older, pre-Luciferian temple — a hidden spiral staircase beneath the swirling floor pattern leads down to the ancient Shrine of Renewal, activated by renewal-aligned power.
A church dungeon lies below — a sunken courtyard lined with cells on three sides, accessed via a mezzanine walkway and stairs, connecting to the tunnel network through multiple doors.
The @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Order of the First Dawn} serves as the Chryseum's paladinic order.
The Chryseum district is accessible via the underground tunnel network.

@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{The Shrine of Renewal}

An ancient, pre-Luciferian chamber hidden beneath the Chryseum, accessible via a concealed spiral staircase activated by renewal-aligned power.
The space is organic rather than constructed — shaped by forces older than the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.yAiIJMlC7flCgMRm]{Imperium}, older than everything the party has encountered save @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.v85bRcnzMrFiDdn6]{The Nodrum} and the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Yaz5mCHyP6xdTwoc]{Witch Stones}.
The chamber predates the Chryseum, the Imperium, and the Luciferian era.
The vines and roots are petrified and desiccated but show faint signs of recovery when a herald is present — small cracks appear and then heal.
At its center rests a translucent cocoon containing the faintest suggestion of a sleeping form — the dormant God of Renewal.
The cocoon radiates faint warmth and contains what appears to be a figure in a fetal position within a translucent membrane.
The cocoon inspires an instinctive, parental urge to protect it in all who behold it.
Those with herald connections feel an interlocking resonance in this place.
Residual renewal energy within the shrine can partially counteract the effects of ruin.
When all six heralds gathered, the cocoon opened and the chamber transformed from desiccated ruin to a verdant, living environment filled with renewal energy.

  • The Cocoon — A translucent cocoon at the chamber's center containing the sleeping God of Renewal; the form within is never clearly resolved, just a curve and shadow suggesting dormant but living presence
  • Hidden Entrance — Concealed beneath the swirling pattern on the Chryseum's nave floor; activated by placing hands on the floor with renewal-aligned power, producing a greenish glow
  • Renewal Energy — Residual energy in the shrine partially counteracts ruin; @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland}'s spellbook pages grew slightly stronger in its presence
  • Herald Resonance — Multiple heralds feel an interlocking connection here, like puzzle pieces drawn together; at least five heralds are needed to unlock the cocoon, but even five proved insufficient without @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Marrow}

@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{The Mendrath Baths}

A gilded bathhouse built by dwarves, accessible via the underground tunnels.

Underground Tunnel Network

Beneath the city lies a network of old mine tunnels and smuggler passages through abandoned gold mines that honeycomb the ground.
Infested with rock rats and prone to cave-ins.
A central junction — possibly a shrine or royal passage built by the city's first king — branches toward the Chryseum, Crest Aurelion, and the Mendrath Baths.
The Aureate patrol the tunnels but typically assign their lowest-ranking soldiers to general duty.
The critical junction is guarded by elite soldiers under @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.w4Jmvexupl7JI1Wo]{Dorn}'s direct command.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2SFTwYFZYk8qTwch]{Tufa} the rock rat warned of undead deeper in the passages.

@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{The Aureate}

@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Albrecht Marrow}'s soldiers, led by @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.w4Jmvexupl7JI1Wo]{First Aureate Eisen Dorn}.
They enforce the law and carry out orders including @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin}'s crackdown against bards and storytellers.

Connected Locations

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.aHJXqousaIFYnECh]{Marrow County} — The county of which Aurelion is the capital
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.v85bRcnzMrFiDdn6]{The Nodrum} — Located not far from the city; the shrine evokes the same ancient resonance
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Yaz5mCHyP6xdTwoc]{Witch Stones} — @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} felt the same deep recognition in the Shrine of Renewal as at the Witch Stones

Associated NPCs

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Albrecht Marrow} — Ruler of Marrow County; the missing herald needed to complete the renewal connection
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.npwR0Fjaz34FwRrN]{Mayliss Vane} — Seneschal to Count Marrow
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.w4Jmvexupl7JI1Wo]{Captain Eisen Dorn} — Captain of the guard
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Luminary Severin Morrow} — Head priest of the Chryseum; can open the shrine's hidden entrance; his family has maintained the shrine for generations
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.wE046R3Drp0snmvQ]{Dawnwarden Brenn} — Leader of the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Order of the First Dawn} at the Chryseum; herald of renewal who guards the Chryseum above

Events Here

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.6Eqkl1MNE1055IJC]{Edric Bloom} talked down angry peasants protesting a grain tax, earning @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.w4Jmvexupl7JI1Wo]{Captain Eisen Dorn}'s respect
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jir5X1jFd08ME0H1]{Session 2} — The party arrived and witnessed Aureate soldiers beating a performer; @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} invoked his authority to free the performer (Jimmy, a Harlequin); the Dark Harlequin manifested briefly inside a water barrel; the party plans to seek the shrine of Renewal beneath the Chryseum
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.u04lXzbSCHW2OEf7]{Session 3} — The party entered covertly through the old mine tunnels to avoid wanted posters; fought through rock rat ambushes and breached past Aureate guards at the tunnel junction leading toward the Chryseum district
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.YxfxYfYC1hm9ZNiA]{Session 4} — @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} was captured and imprisoned in the Chryseum dungeon; the party freed him and discovered the Shrine of Renewal beneath the Chryseum; @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin} and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.wE046R3Drp0snmvQ]{Dawnwarden Brenn} revealed as heralds of renewal; the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Order of the Eclipsed Sword} arrived at Crest Aurelion to arrest @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Marrow}; five heralds felt the interlocking connection at the shrine but could not unlock the cocoon without Marrow; Garland's spellbook responded to the renewal energy
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.c5SHL7wB7yKbx7cP]{Session 5} — The @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Order of the Eclipsed Sword} besieged and breached Crest Aurelion; @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} infiltrated the castle using the secret vault passage to retrieve @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Albrecht Marrow}; Harlequins overran the Chryseum, killing an @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Order of the First Dawn} paladin; @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic}'s divine decree cleared the mob and he beheaded the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{The Dark Harlequin}; all six heralds gathered at the Shrine of Renewal and the cocoon opened, transforming the chamber into a verdant, living space
